name: Read It Say It Make It
description: Read a passage out loud and the tablet listens, marking each word as it is read; then answer about it and make something from it. Speech checking runs on the tablet, offline.

about.concept: Reading fluency with feedback. The child reads a passage aloud and each word lights up as the recognizer hears it, so reading becomes an activity with an immediate, visible result rather than a silent one. Questions and a making step afterwards check that the meaning landed.
about.progression: Sentences read aloud grow from three words at pre-K to two-part sentences at 2nd grade, then passages take over: short stories with a who or what question, main idea paragraphs, fluency passages read with expression, nonfiction with vocabulary in context, inference stories, paired paragraphs to compare, poems, argument paragraphs with a claim and evidence, and 8th grade passages with academic vocabulary and a summary to choose. Every passage is read one sentence at a time and the questions are answered by tapping.
lifeSkills: Turning what was read into something made
